scope: Actual existing general-card captions, separate from independent practice sentences. No new asset, pair, caption or release status has been changed.

followups.actualHeroExcerpt:
The kids are swinging happily on the playground.

孩子們在遊樂場開心地盪鞦韆。
followups.review: One child swings on one swing; another stands cheering. Playground and happy activity align, but plural swinging actors are not all shown. Retain the known U09 literal quantity gap.

followups.actualHeroExcerpt:
Doudou shows generosity by giving both apples to a friend.

豆豆把兩顆蘋果都送給朋友，展現慷慨。
followups.review: Full 1024px original: giver offers one apple to each of two different friends. Actual English says both apples to a friend. Core generosity aligns; recipient count is a confirmed literal caption mismatch. Chinese 朋友 has no independent singular/plural marking.
